description.value: Romper Room is a long-established indoor rock climbing centre that has served the mid Vancouver Island climbing community since 1996, offering 7,500 sq ft of climbing surface including top rope, lead walls, a bouldering cave, auto-belays, and two MoonBoards. The facility welcomes complete beginners through experienced climbers, with rental gear available on site and structured courses ranging from introductory sessions to lead certification. For a touring cyclist visiting Nanaimo, it represents a well-rounded active recreation stop with a strong local community reputation.

The site confirms gear rental and retail on site, but no food service beyond birthday party accommodations.
